profile.headline: Full Stack Web Developer at Epic
profile.summary: Graduated from University of Cincinnati Class of 2015 with a M.S. in Business Analytics.  Also have a B.S. in Mathematics (Statistics) from the University of Cincinnati.

positions.title: Software Developer
